Name: STF - Joja Sells Everything... For a Price
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][size=4][b]STF - Joja Sells Everything[/b]

It’s an overhaul of Joja Market

This version still supports Shop Tile Framework, but it is considered deprecated due to new mechanics introduced in Stardew Valley 1.6. Future game updates may cause compatibility issues, and upcoming versions of this mod may no longer rely on STF.
This release includes multiple added items with individualized unlock conditions, alongside ongoing balance improvements and minor refinements that are still in development.
This version is intended as a foundation for a future transition to Content Patcher-based implementation of the shop system. Feedback, suggestions, and contributions are highly welcome.[/size][/center]
